[engine] Before ggml_reshape_*, confirm the tensor is contiguous; a view that keeps a stride will trip GGML_ASSERT(ggml_is_contiguous) and abort the graph build.

**class**: `source-reading`

## 為什麼（because）

ggml_argsort_top_k returns ggml_argsort followed by ggml_view_4d that keeps nb[1] = n_expert*4 and only cuts ne[0] to k, so the result is not contiguous. ggml_reshape_1d aborted inside the very first reserve build, before a single token was generated.
